front.title: Exact-Action Identifiers in OAuth Authorization Details

abstract.t:
This document defines an action_id member for OAuth Rich Authorization Requests authorization details types that explicitly adopt it. The member carries a scheme-qualified identifier of an action description. A resource server derives an identifier from the operation it is about to perform and compares it with the identifier in the granted authorization details.
The document requests a registry of exact-action identifier schemes and an initial entry for version 1 of the Canonical Action Identifier. It specifies authorization server processing, resource server comparison, and discovery metadata without choosing a universal action vocabulary or digest construction. Identifier equality is an additional condition on authorization; it does not establish permission, a single-use grant, execution, or the truth of externally supplied action data.
